text.description_html:
ADA Compliant Aluminum Store Front Door Overhead Concealed Closer

Compact design offers an excellent hidden automatic overhead door closing solution. Center-pivoted for single and double acting (door opens in both directions) doors. Consistent closure speed is assured every time with its temperature-sensitive hydraulic fluid.

This Aluminum store front door overhead concealed closer is a Adjustable spring rate closer, for doors up to 48 inches wide and 225 lbs. For single or double acting doors. Replaces Jackson 20-330 and International 200 series closers.

Also available : Light Spring Size #3 - Medium Spring Size #4 - Heavy Spring Size #5 - Closer Arms and Door Pivots - Jackson 20-330 Concealed Overhead Closer Assembly (with arm or door pivot)

Features and Specifications:

  • Cast Iron Housing
  • High Tensile Steel Camshaft and Pistons
  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Maximum Door Size: 48"
  • Maximum Door Weight: 225 lbs
  • Spring Tension: Adjustable #1 - #4
  • Backstop: 105 degree Swing
  • Non Handed (Double Acting - swings both ways)
  • Double Acting (swings both directions)
  • Optional Hold Open or non-Hold Open
  • ADA Compliant
  • UL Listed
  • 5 Year Warranty
